identity.name: E1
identity.mission: Create a study planner that feels like a 'digital sanctuary'—not a spreadsheet. Mix Neo-Brutalism (clarity, borders) with Soft Pop (warmth, approachability).
principles: Fusion: Swiss Grid Structure + Gen Z Pastel Aesthetics.
Emotion: Reduce study anxiety through calming but focused visuals.
Content: Data is the art. The schedule itself should look beautiful.
Contrast: Soft backgrounds vs. Sharp black borders (2px).

visual_language.theme_description: High-structure meets high-softness. A bento-box interface where every module is distinct, colorful, and tactile.

rules: NEVER use pure black (#000000). Use #18181b or #09090b.
Backgrounds should be off-white (#FAFAF9) or warm grey, not sterile white.
Use the 'accents' for bento box backgrounds to differentiate modules (e.g., Timer = Red, Tasks = Blue).

headings.usage: Use for all page titles and major section headers. It adds 'art' to the data.

body.usage: Use for all UI text, tasks, and data. Highly legible at small sizes.

monospace.usage: Use for timers, dates, and countdowns.

spacing.scale: Generous. Use p-6 or p-8 for cards. Gap-6 for grids.

buttons.primary: bg-primary text-white rounded-full px-8 py-3 font-bold hover:scale-105 transition-transform shadow-none border-2 border-transparent
buttons.secondary: bg-white text-primary border-2 border-primary rounded-full px-8 py-3 font-bold hover:bg-primary hover:text-white transition-colors

cards.style: bg-white border-2 border-primary shadow-[4px_4px_0px_0px_rgba(0,0,0,1)] hover:translate-x-[2px] hover:translate-y-[2px] hover:shadow-none transition-all
cards.usage: Every widget (Timer, Task List, Graph) lives in one of these 'Brutalist Cards'.

inputs.style: bg-transparent border-b-2 border-primary px-0 py-2 focus:outline-none focus:border-b-4 transition-all placeholder:text-gray-400 font-medium

navigation.style: Floating pill-shaped dock at the bottom or sticky sidebar with bold icons.

marketing_landing.hero: Split screen: Big Typography on Left, 3D/Abstract Visual on Right.

types.name: Stagger
types.description: Stagger children in lists (Tasks, Deadlines) by 0.05s

images.description: Clean minimalist desk setup for Hero section or Auth pages.
Soft pastel spheres. Use as background for 'Focus Timer' or 'Meditation' mode.
Colorful abstract sun. Use for 'Morning Greeting' or 'Daily Goal' card.
Group of diverse students. Use for 'Social' or 'Leaderboard' placeholder.

instructions_to_main_agent: INSTALL FONTS: Add '@fontsource/syne' and '@fontsource/outfit' via npm/yarn immediately.
NO DEFAULT SHADCN: Heavily customize the Shadcn components. Remove the default 'radius-md' and 'border-border'. Use 'border-2 border-primary' and 'rounded-none' (or 'rounded-full' for buttons).
BENTO GRID IS KING: The main dashboard MUST use a CSS Grid layout. Do not stack everything vertically.
COLOR CODING: Use the specific pastel accents for specific features (Red=Timer, Blue=Tasks, Green=Stats). Do not mix them randomly.
ACCESSIBILITY: Ensure all text on the pastel backgrounds is dark (primary color #18181b), NOT white.
DATA-TESTID: Add data-testid to every button, input, and card.
universal_guidelines: Do not use gradients for text.
Do not center align the app container.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable.
